build_checkpoint_engine_worker_extension: build an SGLangCheckpointEngineWorkerExtensionImpl instance with a model runner to enable checkpoint-engine IPC weight updates
run_update_weights_from_ipc: run update_weights_from_ipc on the checkpoint engine worker extension to update model weights via ZMQ IPC
create_get_device_uuid: create a call to get_device_uuid on SGLangCheckpointEngineWorkerExtensionImpl to retrieve the current GPU UUID
test_get_device_id: test get_device_id on SGLangCheckpointEngineWorkerExtensionImpl to verify the current CUDA device ID
review_get_model_loader: review get_model_loader on SGLangCheckpointEngineWorkerExtensionImpl to return the model weight loading callable
